title: Teddy and Peddy's Secret Midnight Snack!
custom_script:
# Scene: bedroom (sitting)
Teddy: {wake} {sniff} Peddy, wake up, I smell a secret midnight *cookie* jar! {idea} [excited, point, shout, ding]
Peddy: {rub-eyes} {laugh} Let us sneak into the kitchen right now! {jump} [happy, wave, excited]
# Time skip: Creeping down the hall...
# Scene: kitchen
Teddy: {open:fridge} Look, the hidden jar of sweet *cookies* is right on the top shelf! {gasp} [surprised, point, shout, gasp]
Peddy: {stretch} Help me reach it before anyone hears us! {sweat} [surprised, think, shout]
# Time skip: A minute of tiptoeing later...
# Scene: kitchen
Teddy: {carry:jar} Got it! Now let us open it very quietly. {hmm} [suspicious, think, calm, sip]
Peddy: {open:jar} {show:cookie} Hand one over before they wake up! {whisper} [excited, point, excited]
# Time skip: Suddenly dropping a crumb...
# Scene: kitchen
Teddy: {drop:cookie} {oops} Oh no, a crumb fell right on the floor! {gasp} [surprised, facepalm, shout, crash]
Peddy: {look-around} Wait, why are those little paws moving near the stove? {shock} [surprised, look-around, shout]
# Time skip: Right behind the counter...
# Scene: kitchen
Cat: {meow} {show:fish} Someone woke me up for a midnight snack too! {laugh} [happy, wave, excited]
Teddy: {scared} A *cat* in the kitchen, hide the jar fast! {hide} [surprised, scared, shout, scream]
# Time skip: Scrambling away...
# Scene: living room
Peddy: {run} Run, it is chasing us across the living room carpet! {sweat} [surprised, run, shout, footsteps]
Teddy: {throw:pillow} Take this shield to block its path! {push} [surprised, point, shout]
# Time skip: Into the hallway...
# Scene: neighbourhood
Peddy: {run} We ran right out the front door into the street! {gasp} [surprised, run, shout]
Teddy: {look-around} Look, the whole *neighbourhood* is completely dark and quiet. {hmm} [suspicious, think, calm]
# Time skip: Trying to hide...
# Scene: park
Peddy: {hide:bush} Let us hide behind these park bushes with our jar! {shrug} [suspicious, shrug, whisper]
Teddy: {eat:cookie} {yay} At least we secured our secret midnight feast! {crunch} [happy, eat, excited, munch]
# Time skip: Morning light...
# Scene: kitchen
Mom: {angry} Who left the empty *cookie* jar out on the table?! {shamp} [angry, hips, shout, angry]
Teddy: {gasp} {sweat} Uh oh, our secret mission is busted! {oops} [surprised, scared, shout, slap]
Peddy: {laugh} {high-five} Worth every single crumb! {yay} [happy, high-five, excited, ding]
